init_weigit_repo: initialize a WeiGit repo in the current working directory for model weight tracking
add_file_to_weigit: add a model weight file to the staged changeset with optional per-tensor tracking
commit_weigit_changes: commit the staged model weight changes with a commit message
checkout_weigit_commit: checkout model weights from a specific commit using its SHA1 hash
view_weigit_status: show the current status of the WeiGit repo including staged and unstaged changes
